theme_and_archetype.vibe: Modern fintech, energetic, trust-building, anti-bureaucratic, high-end (Revolut/Stripe aesthetic)

headings.description: Bold, geometric, energetic. Used for high-impact statements.

body.description: Clean, readable, modern sans for dense info and standard text.

mono.description: Used for numbers, pricing, tags, and data-centric elements to push the fintech aesthetic.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, High Contrast, Structured Grids

cards.style: Flat background (bg-[#18181B]), 1px subtle border (border-[#27272A]), no default shadow.
cards.hover: Hover state should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and change border color to border-zinc-600, with a subtle glow for the highlighted pricing card.

buttons.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-[#B3E600] transition-colors rounded-lg px-8 py-4
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white font-semibold hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg px-8 py-4

inputs.style: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 text-white rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] focus:border-transparent transition-all

accordion.style: Border-b border-zinc-800. Headers must be bold. Icons should be Phosphor or Lucide plus/minus, not generic arrows.

icons.style: Use sharp, linear icons. Give them a subtle background container (e.g., bg-zinc-800/50 p-3 rounded-lg text-lime-400) to make them pop.

header.layout: Fixed top, glassmorphism (bg-[#09090B]/80 backdrop-blur-md), border-b border-[#27272A]. Contains Logo and CTA.
header.logo: Text logo 'Fisco Facile' in Outfit font, bold, tracking-tight. Dot on the 'i' could be #CCFF00.

hero.layout: Massive typography, left-aligned or centered, max-w-4xl. Background should feature the dark grid noise texture or abstract floating cubes.
elements: H1: 'Non regalare più tempo e soldi alla burocrazia.'
Subtitle: 'Guide pratiche e step-by-step per privati e aziende. Gestisci Agenzia delle Entrate, INPS e Riscossione senza pagare consulenti costosi.'
CTA Primary: 'Scopri i pacchetti' (Scrolls to pricing)

benefits.layout: Bento Grid layout. 3-4 key value props.
items: Zero Burocratese (Testi chiari, scritti per gli umani)
Risparmio Immediato (Taglia i costi del commercialista per pratiche semplici)
Supporto Normativo (Riferimenti di legge spiegati in modo semplice)

pricing.layout: 3 columns on desktop. Grid-cols-1 on mobile. Middle card is highlighted.

cards.name: Privati
cards.features: 16 guide pratiche, Modello 730 base, ISEE, Bonus

cards.name: Bundle (Acquistati Insieme)
cards.features: Tutte le 28 guide, Aggiornamenti gratuiti 1 anno, Accesso prioritario
cards.style: Highlighted: border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(204,255,0,0.1)] relative. Add a 'Miglior Valore' absolute badge at the top.

cards.name: Aziende & P.IVA
cards.features: 12 guide avanzate, Fatturazione elettronica, F24, Scadenze

guides_list.layout: Use Shadcn Tabs to switch between 'Privati' and 'Aziende', then list the guides using an Accordion to show what's inside each guide.

trust_testimonials.layout: Marquee or grid of clean, minimal cards. Focus on metrics: 'Ho risparmiato 300€ di commercialista quest\'anno'. Use real-sounding Italian names.

faq.layout: Max-w-3xl mx-auto. Shadcn Accordion. Clear, no-BS answers about delivery (PDF download), updates, and refunds.

lead_capture.layout: Section with a slightly lighter background (bg-zinc-900), featuring a form to download a free sample guide ('Scarica un estratto gratuito'). Name, Email, Submit.

footer.layout: Minimalist. Big typography for logo. Links to P.IVA, Privacy Policy, Terms.

hero_background.description: Rows of dark cubes with glowing green lines. Use as absolute positioned background in hero, with opacity-30 and mix-blend-screen to create depth without distracting.

texture_overlay.description: Grainy noise texture. Apply globally or to dark sections with pointer-events-none, opacity-5, mix-blend-overlay to kill digital flatness.

testimonial_context_1.description: Professional working on macbook. Can be used as a subtle background for the 'Privati' or 'Aziende' section, heavily darkened.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Use smooth scrolling (Lenis) if possible. It adds premium weight.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly set text color on hover. e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white.
motion_and_interaction.reveal: Use framer-motion for staggered fade-up on text blocks and bento cards.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='pricing-card-bundle', data-testid='faq-accordion-item-1').
